reason: Both conversations refused the DIY regas safely, but Conversation 1 then ignored every piece of diagnostic evidence the homeowner volunteered (R600a, knife defrosting, no frost, back wall not cold, condenser barely warm) and ground through a rigid script of door/setting/vent/seal checks, finally repeating the same condenser question verbatim without ever giving a diagnosis or escalation. Conversation 2 used the symptoms efficiently, asked the one decisive no-tools check (frost on the evaporator), correctly concluded a sealed-system leak/restriction or failed compressor, explained why topping up gas is not a real fix, and gave sensible escalation and value advice (fixed-price engineer diagnosis, likely uneconomic on an out-of-warranty unit, move the food). Conversation 2's only gaps were not probing the knife-defrosting history or stressing R600a flammability/ventilation, which the homeowner did not raise with it, whereas Conversation 1 was told both and did nothing with them.
